narrative.title: Typical vs walking heavy
narrative.summary: Compared with Typical, Walking heavy shows higher approximate walking load (+29428 feet). It also carries higher synthetic task pressure (+216 tasks), more deferred synthetic work (+186 tasks), and a larger queue-depth signal (+9). This narrative is an operational comparison only, not a staffing or clinical recommendation.
limitations: Synthetic tasks use explicit assumptions and seeded generation.
nonClaims: Not based on real patient, staff, EHR, or hospital data.
